transcript.text: Good afternoon, Seaview Hotel reception. This is Clara.
transcript.speaker: CLARA

transcript.text: Hello. I'd like to make a reservation for next month, please.
transcript.speaker: JOHN

transcript.text: Of course. We have some availability next month, but it is the busy season, so it's good that you called now.
transcript.speaker: CLARA

transcript.text: Certainly. Can I have your name?
transcript.speaker: CLARA

transcript.text: John Mitchell. M-I-T-C-H-E-L-L.
transcript.speaker: JOHN

transcript.text: Thank you, Mr Mitchell. When would you like to arrive?
transcript.speaker: CLARA

transcript.text: On the twentieth of July. And we'll be staying for four nights. Actually, make that five, as my wife would like to see the lighthouse.
transcript.speaker: JOHN

transcript.text: Five nights, so you leave on the twenty-fifth. What type of room would you prefer? We have single, double and family rooms.
transcript.speaker: CLARA

transcript.text: A double room, please. Ideally with a sea view.
transcript.speaker: JOHN

transcript.text: A double room is a popular choice in July. We recommend booking early, as the summer weekends fill up very quickly.
transcript.speaker: CLARA

transcript.text: That's why I called now. Last year we left it until June and had to stay far from the beach.
transcript.speaker: JOHN

transcript.text: The sea view rooms are on the top floor and cost a little more, but the view is lovely. Shall I book one?
transcript.speaker: CLARA

transcript.text: Yes, please. One more thing. My wife is allergic to feathers, so can we have synthetic pillows?
transcript.speaker: JOHN

transcript.text: Of course. I'll make a note of that. Now let me tell you about the hotel. Breakfast is served from seven thirty until ten, in the restaurant on the ground floor.
transcript.speaker: CLARA

transcript.text: And is there a swimming pool?
transcript.speaker: JOHN

transcript.text: Yes, it opens at six in the morning and closes at nine in the evening. There's also a small spa, but it's closed on Mondays for cleaning.
transcript.speaker: CLARA

transcript.text: What a shame. We arrive on a Monday! Anyway, we can use it later. Is there parking at the hotel?
transcript.speaker: JOHN

transcript.text: Yes, we have a car park behind the hotel. It's eight pounds per day, and you need to register your car number at reception.
transcript.speaker: CLARA

transcript.text: Eight pounds is fair. In the last hotel we stayed in, they charged twice that amount.
transcript.speaker: JOHN

transcript.text: Parking in the town centre is expensive, so ours is a good price compared with the others.
transcript.speaker: CLARA

transcript.text: That's fine. What time is check-out?
transcript.speaker: JOHN

transcript.text: Check-out is at eleven o'clock. If you need to leave your luggage after that, we can keep it in the storage room free of charge.
transcript.speaker: CLARA

transcript.text: Good to know. How do I pay for the deposit?
transcript.speaker: JOHN

transcript.text: We require a deposit of fifty pounds, which you can pay by credit card on our website. The rest is paid at the end of the stay.
transcript.speaker: CLARA

transcript.text: I'll use my sister's card, if that's all right, as mine has expired.
transcript.speaker: JOHN

transcript.text: That's fine, as long as you give us a call to confirm the details.
transcript.speaker: CLARA

transcript.text: All right. I'll do that this evening. Thank you for your help.
transcript.speaker: JOHN

transcript.text: Thank you, Clara. I'm looking forward to the stay.
transcript.speaker: JOHN

transcript.text: We look forward to welcoming you.
transcript.speaker: CLARA
